pages.admin.governance.empty: No governance definitions. Every project uses its own budget, every model is permitted, and no rate limit applies.
pages.admin.governance.field.allowedMode: Comma-separated model names the selected projects may use. Empty means every model.
pages.admin.governance.field.allowedProv: Comma-separated provider ids the selected projects may use. Empty means every provider.
pages.admin.governance.field.celHelp: A boolean predicate over provider, model, customer_id, budget_used and params. team_id, tokens_used, complexity_tier and headers are declared but cannot be evaluated, and a rule that names one is refused on save.
pages.admin.governance.field.failModeHel: How the gateway behaves when the budget counter is unavailable. Leave empty to inherit the platform default.
pages.admin.governance.field.limitUsdHel: Authored in US dollars. Leave empty for no ceiling — this is not the same as 0, which would block every request.
pages.admin.governance.field.mcpAllowlis: Comma-separated server labels or host names. An empty list permits every server.
pages.admin.governance.field.modelsHelp: Comma-separated model names this entry applies to. Empty means every model.
pages.admin.governance.field.name: Name
pages.admin.governance.field.nameHelp: Unique for this type. It identifies the entry in the gateway’s logs and in its status report.
pages.admin.governance.field.priorityHel: The highest-priority matching rule wins. Ties are broken by name, so every gateway replica picks the same rule.
pages.admin.governance.field.projectIdsH: Comma-separated project ids. Empty means every project.
pages.admin.governance.field.providersHe: Comma-separated provider ids this entry applies to. Empty means every provider.
pages.admin.governance.field.requestsPer: Leave empty for no request limit. Counted per project, even for a rule that names no project.
pages.admin.governance.field.softAlertPc: Between 1 and 100. An alert is emitted at this share of the ceiling, before it is reached.
pages.admin.governance.field.tokensPerMi: Leave empty for no token limit. Enforced on the request after the one that crossed it.
pages.admin.governance.help.budget: A spend ceiling in USD. It applies to a project that has no budget of its own; a per-project budget always wins.
pages.admin.governance.help.credentialPo: How usage is accounted: billed normally, metered at zero cost, or excluded from accounting entirely.
pages.admin.governance.help.mcpAllowlist: The MCP servers a request may name. An empty list turns the allowlist off and permits every server.
pages.admin.governance.help.modelConfig: The providers and models the selected projects may use. Leave both empty to exempt those projects from every other allowlist row.
pages.admin.governance.help.rateLimit: Requests and tokens per minute, counted per project. The token ceiling is applied to the request after the one that crossed it, because a request’s token cost is unknown until the provider answers.
pages.admin.governance.help.routingRule: A CEL predicate plus weighted targets. When it matches, the request is dispatched to one of the targets instead. A routed target is still judged by the model allowlist.
pages.admin.governance.propagation: A saved definition takes effect within the gateway’s refresh interval (30 seconds by default), not immediately. The gateway’s /governance/status endpoint reports what it has loaded, and names any entry it rejected or that can match nothing.
pages.admin.governance.readOnlyRow: This entry is authored on the budget-alerts surface. Editing it here would discard its settings.
